affinity.notes: Multicolor projectile streaks avoid assigning a single elemental affinity.

anatomy.notes: Humanoid figure, layered wings, braced legs, and extended arms remain easy to parse.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "ranged skirmisher" does not semantically communicate Glass-Antler Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Parallel projectile lines and the lateral firing stance clearly expose the ranged attack direction.

finish.notes: Wing texture, bark-like costume, forest light, and energy streaks are polished.

framing.notes: Action pose and wings are fully contained with the projectile lanes given room.

identity.notes: Blind perception "butterfly-winged fey marksman" semantically identifies fae/fae-fae-knight.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "mid" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
